svg.title: Detailed request sequence - Group 4
svg.text: Sequence of one write: workload/runner.py -> app/db.py -> driver -> Cassandra -> CSV row
Mode mixed, CL QUORUM, RF 3. Here the driver picked cass1 as coordinator; any replica can be picked. Solid = synchronous, dashed = asynchronous or reply.
CSV on host via bind mount
then CL fixed on the object
18. _record(): log(op=write, cl=QUORUM, key=room, latency_ms, outcome=ok, coordinator)
error paths (no retry: FallthroughRetryPolicy; the row is still logged)
fewer than 2 live replicas at step 9 -> Unavailable -> outcome 'unavailable' (nothing written)
fewer than 2 acks within 2 s -> WriteTimeout -> 'write_timeout' (write may still be applied)
no reply within 5 s -> driver OperationTimedOut -> 'client_timeout'; no reachable node -> 'no_host'
